source3720.reason: The complete source describes physically discarding still-working devices too soon. That reading is understandable, but Oxford’s learner entry for throw aside documents rejecting an attitude or way of life, while throw away/throw out is the usual explicit disposal phrasal verb for possessions. Teaching the source’s physical phrasing as a special idiomatic sense would overclaim; teaching the established figurative sense would drift from the source. A seven-step course would repeat the same premature-disposal judgment and encroach on selected throwaway culture (owner4026), which teaches the systemic habit. Do not force six assessments or replace the source target with throw away.
